paragraphs: Toronto Film School is a private career college in Toronto, Ontario, specialising in creative media programs including film and television production, game design, 3D animation, screenwriting, audio production, and digital marketing. The school provides intensive, industry-focused diploma programs for students seeking careers in entertainment, media, and digital industries.

Located in Toronto — North America's third-largest film and television production hub after Los Angeles and New York — Toronto Film School students have access to a world-class industry ecosystem. Toronto hosts over 1,800 film and television productions annually, providing students with real-world industry exposure and networking opportunities.

International students at Toronto Film School benefit from the school's close ties to Toronto's media and entertainment industry, with many programs featuring industry placements and portfolio-building projects. The school's small class sizes ensure hands-on learning and individual attention from industry-experienced instructors.

Graduates from eligible Toronto Film School programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit. Toronto's booming streaming and digital media sector provides strong employment prospects for graduates in film, VFX, game development, and digital content creation.
paragraphsRu: Toronto Film School — частный карьерный колледж в Торонто, Онтарио, специализирующийся на творческих медиапрограммах: кино- и телевизионное производство, геймдизайн, 3D-анимация, сценарное мастерство и аудиопроизводство.
Расположенный в Торонто — третьем по величине центре кино- и телепроизводства Северной Америки после Лос-Анджелеса и Нью-Йорка — Торонто ежегодно принимает более 1 800 кино- и телепродукций.
Иностранные студенты Toronto Film School получают тесные связи с индустрией медиа и развлечений Торонто, многие программы включают производственные практики.
Выпускники соответствующих программ имеют право на Post-Graduation Work Permit.
